name: SIGETH — Hotel & Guest House Management
tagline: End-to-end guest management plus a bar & restaurant point-of-sales suite.
description: SIGETH is a hotel and guest house management system I built and deployed with SYSIGETH Ltd. It covers the full guest lifecycle — from check-in through check-out — alongside a Sales application that runs the on-site bars and restaurant. The hotel module runs on a networked PostgreSQL database so multiple stations stay in sync, while a standalone single-POS setup falls back to SQLite. The system is live at Poolside View Guest House (Kibagabaga, Kigali), where I was part of the team that installed and configured it on site.
features: Guest management — check-in, stay tracking, and check-out
Point-of-sales application for bars and restaurant orders
Networked PostgreSQL for multi-station hotel deployments
SQLite fallback for standalone single-POS setups
Real-time sales tracking and reporting
Deployed and configured on site at Poolside View Guest House

name: SIGETH Supermarket POS
tagline: Barcode point-of-sales and inventory desktop app for supermarkets.
description: A standalone barcode POS and inventory management desktop app in the SIGETH suite, currently in active development at SYSIGETH Ltd. Products are registered by barcode — auto-generated in-store GS1 codes or scanned manufacturer EAN/UPC — with printable Code 128 labels. Ordering runs through a Scanner POS: scan a barcode, look it up, add to cart, and checkout. All stock movement runs inside atomic transactions so inventory can never go negative or drift.
features: Barcode product registration (in-store GS1 codes or scanned EAN/UPC)
Printable Code 128 product labels
Scanner POS — scan, look up, add to cart, checkout
Atomic stock transactions (stock-in and checkout never drift)
Dashboard with live counts and daily sales history
Offline, single-machine desktop deployment

name: IDA Fleet
tagline: Fleet management & logistics platform — mobile, web, and API.
description: IDA Fleet (ida.rw) is a fleet management and logistics platform for IDA Ltd. that helps businesses track vehicles, manage shipments, and keep expenses and customers under control. It spans a Flutter mobile app for drivers and field operations, a React web dashboard for admins, and a Django REST backend tying everything together.
features: Real-time vehicle and fleet tracking
Shipment and delivery management
Expense and cost tracking per vehicle and trip
Customer management
Flutter mobile app for drivers and field operations
React admin dashboard backed by a Django REST API

name: Pulse
description: Pulse is a planned mobile app that connects blood donors with hospitals in real-time, enabling fast matching by blood type, location, and urgency. The current web version is a working prototype; the mobile app is the next implementation step, focused on reliability and accessibility for users on low-bandwidth connections.
features: Mobile-first donor matching by blood type and proximity
Push notifications for urgent hospital requests
SMS/email fallbacks for offline donors
Donor history & eligibility tracking
Web prototype available — mobile implementation planned

name: Luxe Boutique
tagline: Premium e-commerce platform with real-time seller dashboard.
description: Luxe Boutique is a premium e-commerce platform with separate customer and seller experiences, real-time notifications, and a mobile-first responsive design.
features: Customer portal — browse products, manage cart, track orders
Seller dashboard — manage products, orders, and notifications
Real-time updates via WebSocket-based notification system
Mobile-first responsive design with a polished UI

name: Gender Voice Predictor
tagline: Predicts gender from voice recordings using ML.
description: A full-stack machine learning application that predicts gender from voice recordings using audio feature extraction and classification. The system consists of a React-based frontend and a FastAPI backend with a trained machine learning model.
features: Audio feature extraction from raw voice recordings
Trained on 16,000+ voice samples
FastAPI inference endpoint with React frontend
Currently ~70% accuracy — exploring Microsoft pretrained models for improvements

name: Paccy Unigate
tagline: Scholarships, jobs, and career resources for Rwanda — in one place.
description: A platform that helps students and graduates discover scholarships, job opportunities, and career resources in Rwanda, all in one place.
features: Curated scholarship listings with deadlines and eligibility
Job and internship board tailored to the Rwandan market
Career resources hub (CV tips, interview prep, guides)
Search and filtering across opportunities

name: Icyuzi.rw
tagline: Online marketplace giving stores and shops in Rwanda product visibility.
description: Icyuzi.rw is an online platform where stores and shops list their products for visibility to a wider audience. I worked on it as a backend engineer — designing scalable APIs with Django, modeling product/store relationships in MySQL, and building services that handle large volumes of product data, search, and store management.
features: Scalable backend handling large volumes of product and store data
Multi-store product listing with rich metadata
Store profile and inventory management APIs
Search and filtering across high-volume listings
Role-based access for shop owners and admins

name: Portfolio.dev

Real-time autocomplete with Tab cycling
Data-driven projects & skills
